input.content: Idempotency/recovery key confusion (service.py save): recovery records were looked up by workspace instead of operation_id. Because completed records are kept for audit, any later save on the same workspace with a fresh operation ID matched the old completed record, skipped store.apply, and returned ok with the new ID. The new values were silently dropped. Rule: dedupe/recovery lookups must key on the caller-supplied operation ID. Never key on a domain entity that outlives the operation. Add a test for "fresh op ID, same workspace -> fresh save".
